question: List the dated events in the timeline in which Mary married, or in which one of her husbands died, in time order.
criterion: Mary enters a marriage, or one of her husbands dies.
why_needs_multiple: Bốn mốc là hai lần kết hôn và hai lần chồng qua đời, không gom được thành một mốc.

question: List the dated events in which a new name was adopted, either by Mary herself on marriage or by one of her hotels, in time order.
criterion: Mary takes a new surname on marriage, or one of her hotels is given a new name by renaming or by reopening under a new name.

question: How many calendar years passed between the founding of Metropolitan Properties Ltd and the new will and deed of trust that Mary made in favour of the University of Western Australia?
criterion: Interval between two named events: the founding of Metropolitan Properties Ltd and the new will with its deed of trust.
